messages:
Tess (PM): Quick triage needed — FinSight reported ~40% higher embedding latency on Dedicated since the 2026-03-18 infra change. They flagged production regressions on live routes, requesting either a hotfix or rollback.
Lina (Support): Customer reported spike at 09:12 UTC, attached logs and tracer IDs: trace://fs/abcd1234. They said fallback to hosted is not an option due to data residency.
Rahul (Eng): Can you paste a minimal repro? Is it model-specific or general across deployments?
Lina (Support): Happened on r-infer-ded-1, models: text-embed-1-small & text-embed-1. Logs show increased KV cache miss rate and queuing.
Marta (Solutions): Impacted customer is paying Reserved Dedicated; this is high priority for AE.
Omar (SRE): Rolling back infra change could affect other customers; prefer targeted hotfix if possible.
Rahul (Eng): Initial hypothesis: scheduler change that increased preemption -> batching starvation. Quick mitigation: revert scheduler param `max_preempt_ms` from 5 to 15 on their pool. Small config toggle, low risk.
Tess (PM): If it's a config toggle, can we do a scoped hotfix with canary on their pool?
Rahul (Eng): Yes. I'll open PR with the toggle and a rollout manifest. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4827
DeployBot: PR merged, starting canary: deploy-canary fs-ded-pool -> 5% traffic.
DeployBot: canary metrics: 10m window, latency down 42% vs baseline.
Omar (SRE): Watch memory and KV hit-rate, schedule rollback if any error rate spike >1%.
Lina (Support): I'll message the customer: we'll run a canary and update in 30m.
Marta (Solutions): Recommend offering 2 weeks of committed credits if SLA breach.
Tess (PM): Decision: hotfix config toggle + canary, owner Rahul, ETA hotfix->canary in 30m, full rollout after 60m of stable metrics.
Rahul (Eng): I'll own. Creating internal ticket INT-4391 and queue for emergency release.
Tess (PM): Add rollout notes and comms: canary steps, rollback criteria, customer-facing blurb.
Lina (Support): Copy for customer: "We identified a scheduling parameter causing increased latency for Dedicated pools. We're deploying a targeted fix to your pool and will update within 60 minutes."
Omar (SRE): After full rollout, schedule perf regression postmortem and consider making the toggle default change only after validation.
DeployBot: canary complete, canary metrics OK, starting gradual rollout to 100% over 45m.
Tess (PM): Thanks team — please update INT-4391 with final metrics and close thread when complete. :thumbsup:
